No stop at a favorable seed, no supposed USD3B result from annualizing one month. Any engineering correction requires append-only failure and a prospective registered rerun on new separately named accounts.

cost_provenance.all: No source supplies an observed demand curve, licensing clearance, procurement commitment, complete human productivity benchmark or industrial model-token price. Actual bills remain null. No novelty/royalty/IP monopoly premium or extrapolated industrial unit count.

finite_market.buyer_budget_rule: Each prospect has one finite native wallet initialized once to three times base value. The same prospect and unchanged original budget are passed at renewal/K2; no top-up or new identity. Native funds debit the wallet and native refunds credit that same wallet. Decision bookkeeping additionally reserves authored buyer-side adoption friction; these buyer budgets are never company capital.
finite_market.buyer_value_rule: Reservation value per decision is route base value times (80+5*index)/100, with no demand or low-WTP multipliers applied prospectively. Provider sees posted reservation ceiling and current outside quotes; this is a complete-information one-step price game, not truthful elicitation of private WTP.
finite_market.choice_rule: Buy only if quality/rights are acceptable, budget covers price plus adoption, and utility value-price-adoption strictly exceeds max(0, outside-option utilities). Ties choose an outside option. No forced positive share.
finite_market.identities: route-p00 through route-p07, finite authored procurement actors
finite_market.outside_cost_rule: Free source costs no license fee; its complete checking/integration cost is an explicit uncertain scenario quantity. Conventional, hybrid and rival costs are not human-speed machine calculations or fictional AI salaries. Immediate-copy and 3/6/18/30-month cost-gap cases reduce the currently cheapest complete outside cost to the published compressed floor.
outside_options: free public source plus competent conventional self-service integration
competent human workers with genuinely automated conventional software
finite_market.product_use: A K2 package is distinct approved route-specific evidence, not an additional claim of fresh scientific invention. Same immutable bytes may be nonexclusively distributed; every order pays checking, isolation and support. No cross-route product substitution.
finite_market.renewal_rule: Only successfully collected K1 buyers may receive the one paid support-renewal offer at first-contact plus the scenario collection delay plus8760hours plus1hour, after the inclusive initial support term expires; acquisition, full utility rechoice and a new support term are charged. Cooldown is measured from actual collection. No duplicate churn, free reactivation, defaulted lead resurrection or repeated renewal boundary.
finite_market.source_scope: All population counts, buyer value, adoption friction, alternatives, costs and timing are authored uncertain inputs, not measured market calibration.

funding: Each arm is a separately seeded hypothetical initial equity capitalization. No follow-on financing, debt, capitalized asset, equity subscription or transfer between accounts is supported or executed. Financing refusal opens with zero capital and chooses non-entry. Capital is not company income. Investor required return is not an invented company expense.

obligations.default: The default arm executes native accepted release followed by supported late_reversal: counterparty payment is reversed, the native engine credits the buyer, retains any unpaid refund and stops investments. A separate refund action occurs only if a native refund_due remains. This is a post-settlement provider reversal, not unsupported custody-loss execution or buyer nonpayment after fully funded escrow. No fabricated receivable cash is added.
obligations.rule: Prepay production, independent checking, correction allowance, storage/isolation, annual compatibility maintenance and support before acquisition and an order. Separate native principal collateral/tail remains protected; reserved principal is not another expense. All support costs cover the entire declared term, including any tail beyond the observation horizon. No support reserve silently vanishes. Company escrow funds do not become cash until accepted native release.

optimization: Enumerate the finite posted price grid and non-entry under current public buyer type/outside costs, complete one-order costs, fee and cash requirements. Maximize nonnegative prospective unit contribution among currently feasible quotes. Report the enumerated unit-price bound and exact grid gap. The registered prospecting policy still incurs separately recorded acquisition cost on eligible refused leads; the unit-grid certificate does not optimize or erase that policy's failed-contact costs. No global game equilibrium, truthfulness, unknown-belief probability or enterprise optimality is claimed. Greedy ignores working-capital feasibility only in its declared heuristic, native guards still refuse unaffordable actions.
outputs: New output directory only. private/ holds account recovery/signing files and never enters public exports. public/ holds public native exports, manifests, exact rolling observers, decisions and report. Every export is source-matched audited; independent verifier replays separately. All denominators and negative outcomes retained. No copied balances, pooled accounts or assumption reset.
resources: Finite22 scenarios times5 routes; no stochastic or favorable-seed reruns. No paid models, keys, new spending, external outreach, live contracts or physical actions. Source must be frozen by parent before execution.
rights_policy: Primary rights-unresolved arm refuses commercial licensing. Rights-qualified arms are explicit counterfactuals, not legal clearance. All physical/mission/industrial launch gates remain closed. Missing independently approved route/stage product forbids its offer.
scope: Five separate businesses offering nonexclusive immutable computational evidence packages, checking and prepaid support; not physical production, new scientific work on every order, or market validation

tax.basis: Assess25% of positive cumulative pre-tax modeled profit less earlier assessed tax, floored at zero; no refund or deferred-tax asset is assumed after later losses. Tax accrues as a native expense even if unpaid. This is an authored accounting assumption, not tax advice.

working_capital_control: Matched stress accounts open with setup plus maximum-price collateral plus three per-order fulfillment/acquisition bundles plus three overhead months. Both have identical six/eight prospects, prices, costs and supplier menu. The greedy reach/capacity heuristic prepays unused capacity up to current free cash less50USD without reserving fulfillment/collateral; the aware controller buys only justified delivery resources after preserving one-month overhead, fulfillment, fee and collateral. Capacity is an authored service supplier option, never a built plant. The result tests a specific bad heuristic, not all conventional enterprise management.
